description: The file defines the UpdatePasswordAPI class, a REST API endpoint for updating user passwords within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It handles validation, authorization, and execution of password updates, is annotated with OpenAPI documentation, and utilizes various traits and models specific to the OrangeHRM framework.
